services.desc: Sailing/Sightseeing on the Destin Waters Private Charter: $350 Up to 6 People - All Ages 2 hours! About Sail the emerald waters of the Florida Gulf Coast There is no better way to experience the beauty of this area than sailing and the possibilities are endless Book with us and discover the most beautiful place in the world, with white sandy beaches and emerald water so clear you can witness the charm of Bottle Nose - Dolphins, Sea Turtles and so many other types of aquatic life This is a trip that will stay with you for a lifetime and have you planning your next tour with us $350 • Cruise Only • Doesn't Stop & Swim
